findings.evidence: Code read: corpus rows assert only stdout/stderr/exitCode. git grep for an endless-chain or long-job row in packages/isolate-host/tests and packages/isolate-guest/tests: no hit.
findings.summary: In the isolate host, queued work after exit() still runs and costs time; an endless job ends as timeout. The compat ⚠️ row and the README declare this honestly, but no ceiling row pins it. A fix that stops the dispatchers would turn nothing red, and a regression that makes the time cost worse would pass. Add an it.fails ceiling row, e.g. exit followed by an endless or long ripe job.
